local function generateRandomPassword(length)
    local chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:',.<>?/"
    local password = ""
    for i = 1, length do
        password = password .. chars:sub(math.random(1, #chars), math.random(1, #chars))
    end
    return password
end
